userStories.title: Risk engine - pre-trade validation
userStories.description: As a user, I need the system to block orders that violate my risk limits so I don't accidentally over-leverage.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement pre-trade check function: validateOrder(order, config, currentPositions)

Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed: Created RiskEngine class (src/services/risk-engine.ts) with validateOrder() function that validates orders against RiskConfig and current portfolio state. Implements 7 risk checks: (1) risk_per_trade - blocks if order risk exceeds maxRiskPerTradePercent of account; (2) concentration - blocks if total underlying exposure exceeds maxRiskPerUnderlyingPercent; (3) buying_power - blocks if order cost exceeds available buying power; (4) dte_range - blocks options outside minDTE/maxDTE range; (5) liquidity - blocks if bid-ask spread exceeds configurable threshold (default 5%); (6) max_positions - blocks if position count would exceed limit; (7) max_contracts - blocks if contract count per position would exceed limit. Returns detailed OrderValidationResult with pass/fail status, individual check results with actual vs limit values, and human-readable rejection reasons. All validation attempts logged for audit trail. Added standalone validateOrder() convenience function. Created 37 comprehensive tests (204 total tests pass). Typecheck passes.

userStories.notes: Completed: Created comprehensive kill switch system for emergency stop functionality. (1) src/types/kill-switch.ts defines complete schema with: KillSwitchState (active/inactive), KillSwitchActivator (user/system/automated), KillSwitchReasonCategory (manual/risk_limit/error_cascade/market_conditions/connection_issues/other), KillSwitchConfig (cancelOrdersOnActivation, disableAutoRepriceOnActivation, disableAlertsOnActivation, reEnableCooldownSeconds, requireConfirmationForReEnable), KillSwitchStatus with full state tracking, KillSwitchActivationResult and KillSwitchDeactivationResult, KillSwitchEvent for history, StoredKillSwitchState for persistence. Zod schemas for validation. Helper functions: isKillSwitchActive, isReadOnlyMode, canReEnable, getRemainingCooldownSeconds, formatKillSwitchState, formatReasonCategory, createInactiveStatus, generateStatusSummary, validateKillSwitchConfig. (2) src/services/kill-switch.ts implements KillSwitchService class with: activate() puts system in read-only mode with optional order cancellation, deactivate() with cooldown and confirmation requirements, updateConfig(), onStateChange() callbacks, getStoredState/restoreFromState for persistence, full audit log integration logging config_change events. shouldBlockOperation() and getBlockedOperationMessage() standalone functions for checking if operations should be blocked. (3) API endpoints in server.ts: GET /api/kill-switch (status), POST /api/kill-switch/activate, POST /api/kill-switch/deactivate, PUT /api/kill-switch/config, GET /api/kill-switch/history, GET /api/kill-switch/check/:operation. (4) KillSwitchButton.tsx UI component with: prominent red KILL button, pulsing ACTIVE indicator when engaged, confirmation dialogs for activate/deactivate, cooldown timer display, optional cancel orders checkbox, reason input field, compact mode for header.
